_comment: Maps *UsageDescription Info.plist keys to meaning and sensitivity. Key names follow Apple's Information Property List Key Reference (Protected resources); entries marked iOS 17+/14+ etc. were written from memory (UNVERIFIED against the live docs). The 'level' column is this tool's own heuristic (high = camera/mic/always-location/contacts/photos/health/tracking), not an Apple classification. Keys that are not listed are reported with known=false and level=medium.

NSCameraUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问相机(拍照 / 录像 / 扫码)

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问麦克风(录音 / 语音通话)

NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip.meaning_en: Access location at all times, including in the background

NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 始终访问位置(iOS 11 起已被 AlwaysAndWhenInUse 取代)
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access location at all times (deprecated since iOS 11 in favor of AlwaysAndWhenInUse)

NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access location while the app is in use

NSLocationUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问位置(旧键,主要见于 macOS / 旧版 iOS)
NSLocationUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access location (legacy key, mostly macOS / old iOS)

NSContactsUsageDescription.meaning_en: Read or modify the address book contacts

NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 仅向相册写入照片 / 视频
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription.meaning_en: Add photos or videos to the photo library (write-only)

NSFaceIDUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 使用 Face ID 进行身份验证

NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 使用语音识别(音频可能发送至 Apple)
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.meaning_en: Use speech recognition (audio may be sent to Apple)

NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription.meaning_en: Use Bluetooth to connect to peripherals (iOS 13+)

NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 蓝牙外设共享(iOS 13 起已弃用)
NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription.meaning_en: Share data with Bluetooth peripherals (deprecated since iOS 13)

NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access devices on the local network (iOS 14+)

NSMotionUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问运动与健身(陀螺仪 / 计步等)传感器数据
NSMotionUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access motion and fitness sensor data

NSSiriUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 与 Siri 集成并接收 Siri 请求
NSSiriUsageDescription.meaning_en: Integrate with Siri and receive Siri requests

NSUserTrackingUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 跨 App / 网站追踪用户(App Tracking Transparency, iOS 14.5+)
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription.meaning_en: Track the user across apps and websites (App Tracking Transparency, iOS 14.5+)

NSVideoSubscriberAccountUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问电视服务提供商账号

NSNearbyInteractionUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 使用近场交互(Nearby Interaction / 超宽带)

NSGKFriendListUsageDescription.meaning_zh: 访问 Game Center 好友列表
NSGKFriendListUsageDescription.meaning_en: Access the Game Center friend list
